cancellationAndRefundPolicy.title: Cancellation and Refund Policy

sections.title: Cancellation and Refund
content: The tenant can cancel the reservation before the start of the stay under the following conditions:
- The cancellation must be officially communicated to the host through the app.
- Cancellation fees may apply according to the policy specified during the booking process.
- If the reservation is canceled 7 days prior to the booking date, the full amount will be refunded.
- If the reservation is canceled 4 days prior to the booking date, a 50% cancellation fee will be deducted.
- If the reservation is canceled 2 days or less before the booking date, no refund will be issued.
The cancellation and refund policy may be clearly specified during the booking process, including the allowable cancellation period and applicable fees.

sections.title: Cancellation by the Host
content: The host reserves the right to cancel the reservation in exceptional circumstances, such as unavailability of the accommodation or emergencies.
In case of cancellation by the host, a full refund will be issued to the tenant without any cancellation fees.

sections.title: Communication and Inquiries
content: For any inquiries regarding the cancellation and refund policy, please directly contact the host through the app.
For disputes or additional inquiries, please contact the customer support team via email at support@spotx.app.

cancellationAndRefundPolicy.note: Note: The terms and conditions outlined in the cancellation and refund policy apply to all bookings, tenants, and hosts on the app.
